styleLock.direction: warm minimalist solid-wood bedroom furniture ecommerce detail page
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating cream ivory #F5F2E9 and warm light grey #E8E6E1 infographic sections, one dark charcoal-brown #241F1A bedroom opening, one muted forest trust backdrop; rounded arch dividers with a small copper-orange triangle mark between sections
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm interior ambient with soft directional window light for lifestyle shots, bright even high-key light for infographic screens, soft realistic contact shadows, no contradictory light directions
styleLock.surfaceSystem: natural oak and walnut wood grain surfaces, matte painted walls, soft grey-blue bedding textiles, light wood block material piles
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline 28-48pt in #2D2D2D or #C87A3C, labels 10-14pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters, no serif or handwritten fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line copper-orange rounded icons and circular outline markers, low complexity
styleLock.presentationRules: stable eye-level 3/4 hero angle for room contexts, product always grounded with contact shadow, consistent scale across panels, copy set directly on the scene or card
noDrift: no label style drift between sections
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimalist solid-wood bedroom furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream ivory #F5F2E9, warm light grey #E8E6E1, deep charcoal-brown #241F1A, white cards #FFFFFF, and one copper-orange accent #C87A3C; warm color temperature; modern geometric sans-serif headline typography only; consistent rounded-rectangle info cards and copper pill labels; consistent thin-line copper icons; clean interior photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with copy set directly on the scene or card; natural oak and walnut wood surfaces; rounded arch dividers with a small copper triangle mark between sections; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 深色高对比卧室夜景在信息流中率先抓住视线，并把核心卖点作为标题一并抛出。
shots.camera: eye-level slight 3/4 view of a dark bedroom corner, full product visible beside the bed
shots.lighting: low-key warm ambience, brass table lamp on the product as upper-left key glow, soft warm shadows, no harsh fill
shots.background: deep charcoal-brown matte wall #241F1A, bed edge with muted grey-blue bedding on the right third
shots.props: one brass table lamp on top of the product (lamp is the light source), bed corner enters frame on the right
shots.textZone: top 45% dark wall area carries the copy block: copper-orange #C87A3C main title 「{selling_point_1}」 plus one thin subheading line 「{callout_1}」 in warm off-white
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic opening hero for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Moody dark bedroom interior: deep charcoal-brown wall #241F1A, right third shows a bed edge with muted grey-blue bedding; {product} stands beside the bed at eye-level slight 3/4 view, grounded with a soft contact shadow, the tall dark silhouette filling 50-60% of the frame and reading clearly against the wall. A warm brass table lamp on the product glows as the upper-left key light, soft warm shadows only. Top-left copy block set directly on the dark wall: copper-orange #C87A3C headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with one short subheading line 「{callout_1}」 in warm off-white. Premium interior photography, vertical 2:3 detail page, 2K. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no people, no garbled text, no props covering the product, no cut-off edges, no contradictory light directions, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 源为一张 800 宽详情页长图，按 12 片 800x1200 切片（相邻重叠 60px）逐片读取后拼合分析。主产品为实木床头柜（与源文件名一致）：开场为圆柱条纹橡木款，中后段为白抽屉胡桃木框双屉款，模版统一按 {product} 处理，不锁定具体造型。归类：源文件夹名「家装家具家用品」非 taxonomy 字符串，按 taxonomy 精确串取 L1=家具家纺、L2=卧室家具。已剥离：右上角品牌字标、会员二维码角标、全部原图文案（含 99%/ABS/304 等具体数据与 E0 级等表述，改用 {callout} 占位符重建）、源独特字体排印。源长图第 6-7 屏照片区在源图中即为未加载位，按版面结构重建为照片窗口；第 10 屏报告区原为待回填的空白报告框，升级为可直接出图的实木榫卯抽屉特写收口，不再保留空框；第 12 屏分栏细节行标签重复且与微距特写信息重叠，已合并进 shot-08。
